# Frankfurter

> Currency data API. Current and historical exchange rates for 219 currencies and 39 other assets from 112 central banks and official sources.

No authentication required. Open source. Free, with no quotas or monthly caps.

- OpenAPI: https://api.frankfurter.dev/v2/openapi.json
- Docs: https://frankfurter.dev
- MCP: https://mcp.frankfurter.dev

## Examples

https://api.frankfurter.dev/v2/rates
https://api.frankfurter.dev/v2/rate/eur/usd
https://api.frankfurter.dev/v2/rates?date=1999-01-04&base=usd&quotes=gbp,jpy
https://api.frankfurter.dev/v2/rates?from=2026-01-01&to=2026-01-31&base=eur&quotes=usd
https://api.frankfurter.dev/v2/rates?from=2025-01-01&to=2025-12-31&group=month
